children.name: text
children: {b:COMMENCEMENT}

children.name: text
children: The Employer appoints the Trade-Contractor to carry out the Trade-Contract Works, subject to the terms of this Agreement, and the Trade-Contractor accepts such appointment and agrees to carry out the Trade-Contract Works and act in the best interests of the Employer.

children.name: text
children: The Trade-Contractor shall commence the Sub-Contact Works at the written direction from the Employer.

children.name: text
children: This Agreement takes effect from the date when the Trade-Contractor begins performing the Trade-Contract Works, regardless of the date of this Agreement and it may be terminated in accordance with clause 14.

children.name: text
children: {b:TRADE-CONTRACTOR'S OBLIGATIONS}

children.name: text
children: The Trade-Contractor shall:

children.name: text
children: comply with the terms of this Agreement;

children.name: text
children: carry out and fulfil, in all respects, the duties of a designer under the CDM Regulations;

children.name: text
children: co-operate with the principal designer and provide to the principal designer such information and/or documentation as he shall reasonable request;

children.name: text
children: not, without the Employer’s prior written consent,  make any material change to the designs or specifications for the Project after they have been settled or approved;

children.name: text
children: act fairly and impartially when exercising any power to issue certificates and award extensions of time in connection with the Trade-Contract Works;

children.name: text
children: provide the Employer with as many copies of the “as built” drawings of the Project as the Employer shall reasonably require;

children.name: text
children: carry out and complete the Trade-Contract Works in a proper and workmanlike manner in compliance with the Trade-Contract Documents, any timelines agreed with the Employer and any applicable Statutory Requirements;

children.name: text
children: regularly liaise with the Employer, any other trade-contractors or professional consultants engaged on the Project;

children.name: text
children: comply with any instruction and be bound by any decision of the Employer issued or made under or pursuant to this Trade-Contract;

children.name: text
children: exercise the Required Standard when performing and carrying out the Trade-Contract Works;

children.name: text
children: use reasonable skill, care and diligence to complete any design element of the Trade-Contract Works, including in the selection of any specifications for the kinds and standards of materials, goods and workmanship to be used in the Trade-Contract Works which shall always and as a minimum be of adequate quality. This obligation shall only apply if the Trade-Contract Works include a design or specifying element for which the Trade-Contractor is responsible;

children.name: text
children: observe and abide by the Employer’s health and safety policies as notified to the Trade-Contractor;

children.name: text
children: appoint a competent manager/foreman who shall supervise the carrying out of the Trade-Contract Works at all times, the identity of such person to be notified to the Employer in writing. The Trade-Contractor shall use reasonable endeavours to ensure that the same person acts as the Trade-Contractor's manager throughout the term of the Trade-Contract Works, but may replace that person from time to time where reasonably necessary in the interests of the Trade-Contractor's business, subject upon giving written notice to the Employer;

children.name: text
children: observe the site working hours as determined by the Employer and the Trade-Contractor shall not work any overtime without first obtaining the written consent of the Employer. No additional payment will be made in respect of overtime working unless such overtime working is specifically requested in writing by the Employer;

children.name: text
children: provide everything required to carry out, complete and maintain the Trade-Contract Works including all plant and machinery, tools and equipment and these items shall not be removed from the Property without the prior written permission of the Employer. These items which are not on site for incorporation in the Trade-Contract Works shall be at the sole risk of the Trade-Contractor;

children.name: text
children: clear away all rubbish and debris resulting from the Trade-Contract Works to such a location upon the Property as identified by the Employer. Failure to do so may result in the Employer, at the Trade-Contractor’s costs, to clear away such rubbish and debris and these costs may be deducted from the any monies due or which may become due to the Trade-Contractor;

children.name: text
children: to perform the Trade-Contract Works and prepare all Material for those elements of the Project for which the Trade-Contractor is responsible for in sufficient time to facilitate the efficient progress of the Project;

children.name: text
children: not to cause or contribute to any breach by the Employer of any Third Party Agreement provided that, where the Employer notifies the Trade-Contractor of a Third Party Agreement after the date of this Agreement, the Trade-Contractor is not required to act in any way that may increase its liability in excess of that which was reasonably foreseeable at the date of this Agreement; and

children.name: text
children: at its own risk and for the purposes of carrying out the Trade-Contract Works have free use of any scaffolding provided by the Employer whilst it remains erected but thereafter will supply, erect and dismantle its own scaffolding and will make good at his own cost any damage, loss or injury suffered by the Employer or others as a result of such use, erection or dismantlement.

children.name: text
children: The Trade-Contractor shall not specify for use nor use in connection with the Trade-Contract Works any materials that by their nature or application are at the time of specification or use Deleterious and provide the Employer with reasonable proof that any materials and goods specified or used comply with this Clause 3.2.

children.name: text
children: If the Trade-Contractor becomes aware of any divergence between the Statutory Requirements, Trade-Contract Documents and any instruction provided by the Employer, it shall immediately notify the Employer.

children.name: text
children: In so far as any design of the Works is undertaken by the Trade-Contractor, the Trade-Contractor shall in respect of any inadequacy in such design have the same liability to the Employer as would an architect or other appropriate professional designer who holds himself out as competent to take on work for such design. Where and to the extent that the Trade-Contract involves the Trade-Contractor in taking on work for or in connection with the provision of a dwelling or dwellings, the Trade-Contractor’s liability shall include liability under the Defective Premises Act 1972.

children.name: text
children: [The Trade-Contractor warrants that, to the best of its knowledge, it has the necessary competence and has allocated or, as appropriate, will allocate adequate resources to comply with its obligations as designer under the CDM Regulations and that any information provided by the Trade-Contractor regarding such competence and resources is accurate and complete in all respects. To the extent that such information ceases to be an accurate and complete representation of such competence and resources, the Trade-Contractor will immediately notify the Employer. ]

children.name: text
children: The Trade-Contractor has no authority, without the prior written consent of the Employer, to:

children.name: text
children: make any alteration to the Project or the Trade Contract Works,:

children.name: text
children: vary, terminate or waive compliance with the terms of any Third Party Agreement;

children.name: text
children: enter into any contract, commitment or undertaking on behalf of the Employer; or

children.name: text
children: issue any instruction or notice that delays the Project or increases the costs of the Project.

children.name: text
children: The Trade-Contractor’s duty of care under this Agreement shall not be negated or diminished by:

children.name: text
children: any approval or inspection of the Property, the Project or any designs or specifications for the Property or the Project;

children.name: text
children: any testing of any work, goods, materials, plant or equipment; or

children.name: text
children: any omission to approve, inspect or test,

children.name: text
children: by or on behalf of the Employer.

children.name: text
children: {b:EMPLOYER'S OBLIGATIONS}

children.name: text
children: The Employer shall:

children.name: text
children: act as construction manager in connection with the Project;

children.name: text
children: co-ordinate and co-operate with the Trade-Contractor in all matters relating to the Trade-Contract Works;

children.name: text
children: provide for the Trade-Contractor, its agents, consultants and employees, in a timely manner and at no charge, access to the Property as required by the Trade-Contractor and the Trade-Contractor shall permit the Employer and/any other person notified by the Employer, reasonable access to the Trade-Contract Works at any time; and

children.name: text
children: provide to the Trade-Contractor in a timely manner all documents, information, items and materials in any form (whether owned by the Employer or a third party) reasonably required by the Trade-Contractor in connection with the Trade-Contract Works.

children.name: text
children: The Employer gives no warranty as to the position, dimension levels and/or suitability of any work previously carried out by any contractor or trade-contractor or sub-contractor and the Trade-Contractor shall, before commencing the Trade-Contract Works, notify the Employer in writing if any such previous works is unsatisfactory.

children.name: text
children: The Trade-Contractor shall not be entitled to make any claim against the Employer in respect of any such previous work or for any loss, damage or expense incurred as a result of such work being defective or unsatisfactory unless he shall have notified the Developer in accordance with clause 4.2.

children.name: text
children: {b:CHANGES TO THE SUB-CONTRACT WORKS}

children.name: text
children: The Trade-Contractor shall be deemed to have visited the Property and have fully acquainted itself with the relevant drawings and specifications and to be fully aware of all matters effecting the Trade-Contract Works and to have made sufficient allowances in his price to cover all and any items.

children.name: text
children: The Trade-Contract Sum will not be increased in any way to cover any increase in the cost of labour, plant, materials or any other items used in the carrying out of the Trade-Contract Works unless agreed in writing by a director of the Employer and the Project Surveyor.

children.name: text
children: The Trade-Contractor shall carry out any reasonable changes to the Trade-Contract Works or changes to the order or manner in which they are to be carried out as directed in writing by the Employer (“Change”).

children.name: text
children: The parties shall endeavour to agree a price prior to the Trade-Contractor carrying out the Change. If the parties cannot agree a price for such Change then the price shall be that which the Employer shall in its reasonable discretion consider to be fair and reasonable.

children.name: text
children: In the event that the Trade-Contractor considers the Trade-Contract Works, or part thereof, to be executed should be valued on a day work basis the Trade-Contractor shall prior to the execution of any such works give notice in writing to the Employer stating why it considers day work to be the appropriate basis for valuation purposes.

children.name: text
children: After written approval to execute works on a day work basis has been given by the Employer, the Sub- Contactor shall submit each day a detailed record sheet showing the labour, plant and materials deployed. The signing of record sheets for or on behalf of the Employer shall not oblige the Employer to pay for the work described therein on a daywork basis, or at all, unless prior written approval for dayworks has been given by the Employer’s contract surveyor.

children.name: text
children: {b:EXTENSIONS OF TIME AND DAMAGES FOR DELAYS/NON-COMPLETION}

children.name: text
children: If it becomes apparent that the Trade-Contract Works will not be completed by the date agreed between the parties, the Trade-Contractor shall thereupon notify the Employer. Where the delay occurs for reasons beyond the control of the Trade-Contractor including any compliance with the Employer’s instructions that are not occasioned by a default of the Trade-Contractor, the Employer shall give such extension of time for completion as may be reasonable and notify the Trade-Contractor accordingly.

children.name: text
children: If it becomes apparent that the Trade-Contract Works will not be completed by the date agreed between the parties or such later date fixed by the Employer under clause 6.1, the Employer may require the Trade-Contractor to pay or allow to the Employer Liquidated Damages between the date for completion agreed between the parties and the date of practical completion.

children.name: text
children: The Employer may deduct the Liquidated Damages from any sum due to the Trade-Contractor under this Agreement (provided a notice of such deduction has been given under clause 9.7) or recover those damages from the Trade-Contractor as a debt.

children.name: text
children: The Trade-Contractor shall constantly use his best endeavours to prevent or minimise any delay in the progress of the whole or any part of the Trade-Contract Works.

children.name: text
children: {b:PRACTICAL COMPLETION}

children.name: text
children: The Employer shall certify the date when, in its reasonable discretion, the Trade-Contract Works have reached practical completion.

children.name: text
children: {b:MAINTENANCE AND DEFECTS}

children.name: text
children: From the Commencement Date and throughout the Maintenance Period, the Trade-Contractor shall upon receipt of notice from the Employer carry out and complete such maintenance work as be necessary to any dwelling and the Trade-Contractor shall comply with the following timelines:

children.name: text
children: Emergency maintenance work (“EMW”) must be carried out and completed immediately; and

children.name: text
children: non-emergency maintenance work must be carried out and completed within 48 hours from receipt of such notice unless stated otherwise by the Employer.

children.name: text
children: The Trade-Contractor shall in addition to its liabilities under this Agreement indemnify the Employer against any liability arising under an NHBC guarantee in respect of the Trade-Contract Works.

children.name: text
children: In the event that any defects, shrinkages or other faults are caused by the act, omission, neglect or default of the Employer or its servants or agents then the Trade-Contractor shall be entitled to be paid by the Employer its reasonable costs of making such matters good.

children.name: text
children: The Employer reserves the right at its sole and unfettered discretion to itself or through others to carry out EMW to the exclusion of the Trade-Contractor. The Trade-Contractor acknowledges the crucial importance and urgent nature of EMW and confirms that it shall not contend (and nor shall the Employer be deemed) that in so doing the Employer has failed to discharge any duty to mitigate.

children.name: text
children: Should the Trade Contract fail to carry out and complete any maintenance work (including for the avoidance of doubt any EMW) in accordance with the provisions of this clause either on time or at all, then the Employer may itself or through others do so and recover the costs and expenses of so doing from the Trade-Contractor by deduction, abatement, proceedings or otherwise.

children.name: text
children: {b:CHARGES AND PAYMENT}

children.name: text
children: In consideration of the provision of the Trade-Contract Works by the Trade-Contractor, the Employer shall pay the Trade-Contract Sum.

children.name: text
children: The Trade-Contract Sum shall be paid in accordance with the payment schedule agreed to in writing between the parties.

children.name: text
children: The Trade-Contract Sum are exclusive of VAT and in relation to any payment to the Trade-Contractor under this Agreement, the Employer shall in addition pay the amount of any VAT properly chargeable in respect of it. The Trade-Contractor shall co-operate with the Employer and do all that the Employer may reasonably request in respect of the provision of documents and information relating to the payment of valued added tax in order that the provision of the Value Added Tax (General) Regulations, 1980 and any amendment thereto, may be properly complied with.

children.name: text
children: The Trade-Contractor shall submit to the Employer an invoice for each instalment of Trade-Contract Sum in accordance with the payment schedule, together with a payment request form (signed by the site manager) and any supporting documents that are reasonably necessary to check the invoice. The invoice and supporting documents (if any) shall specify the sum that the Trade-Contractor considers will become due on the payment due date in respect of the instalment of the Trade-Contract Sum, and the basis on which that sum is calculated.

children.name: text
children: Payment shall be due on the date the Employer receives each invoice.

children.name: text
children: No later than five days after payment becomes due, the Employer shall notify the Trade-Contractor of the sum that the Employer considers to be due at the payment due date in respect of the payment and the basis on which that sum is calculated.

children.name: text
children: The final date for payment shall be 30 days after the date on which payment becomes due.

children.name: text
children: Unless the Employer has served a notice under clause 9.7, it shall pay the Trade-Contractor the sum referred to in the Employer's notice under clause 9.4 (or, if the Employer has not served notice under clause 9.4, the sum referred to in the invoice referred to in clause 9.2) (in this clause 9, the “notified sum”) on or before the final date for payment of each invoice.

children.name: text
children: Not less than seven days before the final date for payment (in this clause 9, the “prescribed period”), the Employer may give the Trade-Contractor notice that it intends to pay less than the notified sum (in this clause 9, a “pay less notice”). Any pay less notice shall specify:

children.name: text
children: the sum that the payer considers to be due on the date the notice is served; and

children.name: text
children: the basis on which that sum is calculated.

children.name: text
children: Where a pay less notice is given in accordance with this clause 9.7, the obligation to pay the notified sum in clause 9.6 applies only in respect of the sum specified in that pay less notice.

children.name: text
children: If the Employer fails to pay an amount due to the Trade-Contractor by the final date for payment and fails to give a pay less notice under clause 9.7, then the Employer shall pay interest on the overdue amount at the rate of 4% per annum above the Bank of England's base rate from time to time. Such interest shall accrue on a daily basis from the final date for payment until actual payment of the overdue amount, whether before or after judgment. The Employer shall pay interest together with the overdue amount. The parties acknowledge that the Employer's liability under this clause 9.8 is a substantial remedy for the purposes of section 9(1) of the Late Payment of Commercial Debts (Interest) Act 1998.

children.name: text
children: The first half of the Retention (2.5%) shall be released to the Trade-Contractor within one month of practical completion of the Trade-Contract Works and the second half of the Retention (2.5%) shall be released within one month of the expiry of the Maintenance Period, subject to the rectification of all defects by the Trade-Contractor as notified under clause 8.

children.name: text
children: No payment under this Agreement will be made until and unless the Trade-Contractor delivers to the Employer:

children.name: text
children: a duly executed counterpart of this Agreement; and

children.name: text
children: up to date evidence of the insurances it is required to maintain under clause.

children.name: text
children: The Employer may at any time set off any liability of the Trade-Contractor to the Employer  against any liability of Employer to Trade-Contractor, whether either liability is present or future, liquidated or unliquidated, and whether or not either liability arises under this Agreement. Any exercise by the Employer of its rights under this clause shall not limit or affect any other rights or remedies available to it under this Agreement or otherwise.

children.name: text
children: {b:TAX DEDUCTION SCHEME}

children.name: text
children: The Trade-Contractor shall in all respects comply with the provisions of the Acts of Parliament and all Regulations made there under relating to deduction of income or corporation tax or national insurance contributions, as may be from time to time amended or re-enacted.

children.name: text
children: Payment of the Trade-Contractor will only be effected upon prior production to the Employer of:

children.name: text
children: for CIS4 sub-contractors- a valid registration card (in which case payment will be made net after deduction of tax and national insurance);

children.name: text
children: for CIS5 sub-contractors- either a valid tax certificate or a “certifying document” prepared in accordance with the requirements of the Income and Corporation Taxes Act, 1988, Sections559 to 567 and by 51:1998

children.name: text
children: for CIS6 sub-contractors - a valid tax certificate.

children.name: text
children: No payment will become due or payable or will be made until and unless the Trade-Contractor has produced the original of a valid card certifying document or certificate.

children.name: text
children: If the Trade-Contractor is a holder of a valid CIS6 tax certificate and fails to issue to the Employer a properly completed sub-contractor’s gross payment voucher (CIS24) as and when appropriate or as requested by the Employer no further or subsequent payment shall become due or payable to the Trade-Contractor until the same is received.

children.name: text
children: {b:TITLE IN MATERIALS}

children.name: text
children: Where any goods or materials for incorporation in the Trade-Contract Works have been included in any interim payment prior to or following delivery to site then upon payment being made to the Trade-Contractor the property in such goods and materials shall immediately pass to the Employer, subject at all times to the provisions of clause 9.

children.name: text
children: Notwithstanding that such goods or materials may have become the property of the Employer hereunder the Trade-Contractor shall continue to be responsible for any damage to or loss of the same until fully and finally incorporated in the Trade-Contract Works.

children.name: text
children: {b:COPYRIGHT}

children.name: text
children: Copyright in all designs, drawings, models, plans, details, specifications, bills of quantities, schedules, photographs, brochures, notes of meetings, CAD materials, reports, records, data, databases, programmes, budgets, calculations and all other documents and materials including computer software and revisions of the same (“Documents”) prepared by the Trade-Contractor for the purposes of the Trade-Contract Works remains the property of the Trade-Contractor.

children.name: text
children: The Trade-Contractor grants to the Employer a perpetual, royalty-free, irrevocable, non-exclusive licence together with a right to grant sub-licences to use and reproduce the Documents and any designs contained in them for any purpose relating to the Trade-Contract Works.

props.className: edit-document-table table tc full-width no-border justified

children.name: text
children: {b:INJURY, DAMAGE AND INSURANCE}

children.name: text
children: The Trade-Contractor shall:

children.name: text
children: be liable for, and shall indemnify the Employer against, any expense, liability, loss, claim or proceeding whatsoever in respect of personal injury to or death of any person arising out of or in the course of or caused by the carrying out of the Trade-Contract Works, except to the extent that the same is due to any act or neglect of the Employer; and

children.name: text
children: be liable for, and shall indemnify the Employer against, any expense, liability, loss, claim or proceedings in respect of any loss, injury or damage whatsoever to any property real or personal (other than loss, injury or damage to the Trade-Contract Works and/or existing structures or their content) in so far as such loss, injury or damage arises out of or in the course of or by reason of the carrying out of the Trade-Contract Works and to the extent that the same is due to any negligence, breach of statutory duty, omission or default of the Trade-Contractor.

children.name: text
children: The Trade-Contractor shall effect and maintain the following insurance with a reputable insurance provider approved by the Employer:

children.name: text
children: adequate insurance to cover any claim arising out of its liabilities referred to in clause 13.1;

children.name: text
children: employer’s liability insurance in the amount of {EmployersLiabilityRequirement} in respect of any one incident or occurrence;

children.name: text
children: public liability insurance in the amount of {PublicLiabilityRequirement} in respect of any one incident or occurrence;

children.name: text
children: product liability insurance in the of {ProductLiabilityRequirement} in respect of any one incident or occurrence;

children.name: text
children: professional indemnity insurance in the amount of {ProfessionalLiabilityRequirement} in respect of any one incident or occurrence;

children.name: text
children: required by any statute including but not limited to, third party public liability risks in connection with any vehicles or powered equipment used in connection with the Sub- Contract Works including maintenance thereof; and

children.name: text
children: provides cover against all risks including terrorism usually insured under a “Contractor’s All Risks Policy” for loss of or damage to the Trade-Contract Works and any materials and goods for which the Trade-Contractor is responsible under the terms of this Sub Contract but excluding equipment owned or hired by the Employer or any other trade contractor or sub-contractor for the full value thereof (plus 15% to cover professional fees) and shall keep such Trade-Contract Works and any materials and goods insured until Trade-Contract Works are completed. The Sub- Contractor shall forthwith restore, replace or repair any work materials or goods lost or damaged as aforesaid, remove and dispose of all debris and carry out and complete the remainder of the Trade-Contract Works. The Trade-Contractor shall only be entitled to retain such monies as are paid out (less the aforesaid percentages) under the insurances provided for under this sub-clause and shall receive such monies as and when they are paid out under such insurances and in the same manner as interim payments are provided for herein. For the avoidance of doubt in this sub-clause “materials and goods” shall be deemed to include plant, hutting and contents owned by the Trade-Contractor or for which he is responsible including that owned by the Employer and/or hired to the Trade-Contractor.

children.name: text
children: The insurance cover specified at clause 13.2.4 shall be maintained and continued for a period of 12 years from the date of practical completion as certified under clause 7, or if practical completion is not achieved from the date of performance the last Trade-Contract Works.

children.name: text
children: The Trade-Contractor shall cause any sub-trade-contractor to maintain such insurances as are specified herein in the joint names of the Employer, the Trade-Contractor and the sub-trade-contractor.

children.name: text
children: The Trade-Contractor shall on request supply to the Employer copies of the insurance policies which the Trade-Contractor is required to maintain and evidence that the relevant premiums have been paid. the Sub- Contractor fails to provide or maintain such insurance the Employer may obtain the insurance itself (but shall he under no obligation to do so) and deduct the cost thereof from sums due or to become due to the Trade-Contractor.

children.name: text
children: {b:SUSPENSION}

children.name: text
children: The Employer may, at any time, suspend performance of all or part of the Trade-Contract Works by giving written notice to the Trade-Contractor. Subject to clause 15.2, the Trade-Contractor shall resume performance of the Trade-Contract Works as soon as reasonably practicable after receiving a written notice to do so from the Employer.

props.className: edit-document-table table tc full-width no-border justified

children.name: text
children: {b:TERMINATION}

children.name: text
children: The Employer may termination this Agreement with immediate effect by giving written notice to the Trade-Contractor if:

children.name: text
children: for a period of seven days after receiving the written direction from the Employer to commence the Trade-Contract Works in accordance with clause 2.1, fails to commence or proceed with the Trade-Contract Works;

children.name: text
children: fails to carry out or perform any of its obligations or duties in accordance with this Trade-Contract, or suspends the carrying out of the Trade-Contract Works before completion including (without prejudice to the generality of the foregoing) failing to proceed with the Sub- Contract Works in accordance with the site development programme or the Employer’s instructions or in any event;

children.name: text
children: fails to rectify any defects within the required time period as notified to it under clause 8; or

children.name: text
children: becomes bankrupt or makes a composition or arrangement with his creditors, or has a proposal made for a voluntary arrangement for a composition of debts or scheme of arrangement approved in accordance with the Insolvency Act 986 or is the subject of an application to the Court under the Insolvency Act 1986 for the appointment of an administrator or has a winding up order made against it or (except for the purposes of amalgamation or reconstruction in a state of solvency) a resolution for voluntary winding up passed; or has a provisional liquidator, receiver, or receiver and manager of its business or undertaking or any part thereof duly appointed or has administrative receiver as defined in the Insolvency Act 1986 appointed or has possession taken by or on behalf of the holders of any debentures secured by a floating charge of any properly comprising or subject to the floating charge; or suffers an execution against his goods which remains unsatisfied for more than seven days.

children.name: text
children: If:

children.name: text
children: a suspension of the Trade-Contract Works in accordance with clause 14 continues for a continuous period of six months; and

children.name: text
children: the Employer does not instruct the Trade-Contractor to resume the Trade-Contract Works within 21 days of receiving a written notice from the Trade-Contractor requiring it to do so,

children.name: text
children: the Trade-Contractor may immediately terminate its engagement under this Agreement by giving written notice to the Employer.

children.name: text
children: The Employer shall at its option be entitled instead of determining this Agreement under this clause to take part only of the Trade-Contract Works from the Sub- Contractor and may complete such part of the Trade-Contract Work’s itself or through its servants or agents or others and in such event may recover its reasonable costs of so doing from the Trade-Contractor.

children.name: text
children: {b:CONSEQUENCES OF TERMINATION}

children.name: text
children: On termination of this Agreement:

children.name: text
children: the Trade-Contractor shall return any deposit or advance payment made by the Employer to the Trade-Contractor for any Trade-Contract Works not yet performed or delivered at the time this Agreement is determined;

children.name: text
children: all plant, goods and materials delivered to the site by or for the use of the Trade-Contractor shall be deemed to be the property of the Employer notwithstanding that the title thereto may not have previously passed to the Employer in accordance with clause 11 hereof or otherwise unless the Employer shall disclaim ownership by notice in writing to the Sub- Contractor,

children.name: text
children: the Employer may take possession of and use, permit other trade-contractors or sub-contractors to use, all such plant, goods and materials;

children.name: text
children: the Sub-contractor shall if required at any time by the Employer forthwith remove from site all such plant, goods and materials and failing such removal the Employer may remove and sell the same and hold the proceeds after deduction of the costs of removal and/or sale to the account of the Trade-Contractor (after deducting any such monies as may be due from the Trade-Contractor to the Employer); and

children.name: text
children: the Trade-Contractor shall allow or pay to the Employer the amount of any loss and damage caused to the Employer by reason of such determination.

children.name: text
children: The obligations provided for at clauses 12.2, 13.2.4 and 13.3 shall survive and continue notwithstanding any suspension or termination of this Agreement.

children.name: text
children: {b:ANTIQUITIES}

children.name: text
children: All fossils, antiquities and other objects of interest or value, which shall be discovered on the site during the progress of the works, shall become the property of the Employer.

children.name: text
children: Upon discovery of any such object the Trade-Contractor shall forthwith inform the Employer and shall take all steps that may be necessary to preserve such objects.

children.name: text
children: In the event that the discovery of such fossils, antiquities and other objects of interest or value shall cause English Heritage or some other such body to place a restraint or injunction preventing the commencement or continuance of the works the Employer shall not be liable for any cost or expense that such restraint or injunction may cause to the Trade-Contractor.

children.name: text
children: {b:DISPUTES}

children.name: text
children: Notwithstanding any other provision in this Agreement, either party may at any time refer any dispute under it to adjudication under the Scheme for Construction Contracts (England and Wales) Regulations 1998, Part 1 (as amended).

children.name: text
children: The adjudicator’s decision is binding until the dispute or difference is finally determined by litigation. The Employer and Trade-Contractor shall agree the identity of the adjudicator. If the parties fail to reach such agreement within two days after one party notifies the other that it wishes to agree the identity of the adjudicator, the adjudicator is appointed by the President or Vice-President for the time being of RICS. Any dispute or difference in connection with the enforcement of a decision of the adjudicator is referred to the courts.

children.name: text
children: {b:FORCE MAJEURE}

children.name: text
children: Neither party shall be in breach of this Agreement or otherwise liable for any failure or delay in the performance of its obligations if such delay or failure results from events, circumstances or causes beyond its reasonable control. The time for performance of such obligations shall be extended accordingly. If the period of delay or non-performance continues for 4 weeks, the party not affected may terminate this Agreement by giving 14 days' written notice to the affected party.

children: {b:ASSIGNMENT AND OTHER DEALINGS}

children.name: text
children: The Trade-Contractor shall not assign, transfer, mortgage, charge, subcontract, delegate, declare a trust over or deal in any other manner with any of its rights and obligations under this Agreement without the Employer’s prior written consent.

children.name: text

No single or partial exercise of any right or remedy provided under this Agreement or by law shall prevent or restrict the further exercise of that or any other right or remedy.

children.name: text

children.name: text

children.name: text

children.name: text

Each party agrees that it shall have no claim for innocent or negligent misrepresentation [or negligent misstatement] based on any statement in this Agreement.

children.name: text

children.name: text

children.name: text
children: The rights of the parties to rescind or vary this Agreement are not subject to the consent of any other person.

Any notice from the Trade-Contractor shall specify the grounds for the Trade-Contractor’s proposed termination.

children.name: text
children: If the Trade-Contract allows the Trade-Contractor a shorter notice period for the exercise of a right referred to in clause {b:4.1}, the notice period in the Trade-Contract shall be extended to take account of the notice period required under clause {b:4.1}.

children.name: text
children: The Trade-Contractor's right to terminate its employment under the Trade-Contract shall cease if, within the period referred to in clause {b:4.1}, the Beneficiary gives notice to the Trade-Contractor, copied to the Employer:

children.name: text
children: requiring the Trade-Contractor not to terminate its employment under the Trade-Contract;

children.name: text
children: acknowledging that the Beneficiary (or its nominee) will assume all the Employer's obligations under the Trade-Contract; and

children.name: text
children: undertaking that the Beneficiary or its nominee will pay to the Trade-Contractor:

children.name: text
children: any sums that may subsequently become due and payable to the Trade-Contractor under the SubContract; and

children.name: text
children: within five Business Days any sums then due and payable to the Trade-Contractor under the Trade-Contract that are unpaid.

children.name: text
children: If the Beneficiary (or its nominee) serves notice on the Trade-Contractor under clause {b:4.3}, then, from the date of service of the notice, the Trade-Contract shall continue in full force and effect, as if the Trade-Contractor's rights to terminate had not arisen and as if it had been entered into between the Trade-Contractor and the Beneficiary (to the exclusion of the Employer).

children.name: text
children: In complying with this clause {b:4}, the Trade-Contractor:

children.name: text
children: does not waive any breach of the Trade-Contract or default under the Trade-Contract by the Employer; and

children.name: text
children: may exercise its right to terminate its employment under the Trade-Contract, after the expiry of the notice period referred to in clause {b:4.1}, unless the Trade-Contractor's right to terminate or discontinue has ceased under clause {b:4.3}.

children.name: text
children: {b:STEP-IN RIGHTS: BENEFICIARY MAY STEP-IN}

children.name: text
children: Without affecting clause 4.1, if the Beneficiary serves a notice on the Trade-Contractor, copied to the Employer, that:

children.name: text
children: confirms that the Beneficiary wishes to step-in to the Trade-Contract; and

children.name: text
children: complies with the requirements for a Beneficiary's notice under clause {b:4.3},

children.name: text
children: then, from the date of service of the notice, the Trade-Contract shall continue in full force and effect, as if it had been entered into between the Trade-Contractor and the Beneficiary (to the exclusion of the Employer).

children.name: text
children: The Trade-Contractor shall assume that, between the Employer and the Beneficiary, the Beneficiary may give a notice under clause {b:5.1}. The Trade-Contractor shall not enquire whether the Beneficiary may give that notice.

children.name: text
children: In complying with this {em:clause {b:5}}, the Trade-Contractor does not waive any breach of the Trade-Contract or default under the Trade-Contract by the Employer.

children.name: text
children: {b:STEP-IN RIGHTS: TRADE-CONTRACTOR'S POSITION AND EMPLOYER'S CONSENT}

children.name: text
children: The Trade-Contractor shall not incur any liability to the Employer by acting in accordance with clause {b:4} or clause {b:5}.

children.name: text
children: The Employer has executed this agreement to confirm its consent to the agreement.

children.name: text
children: {b:STEP-IN RIGHTS: BENEFICIARY'S GUARANTEE}

children.name: text
children: If a Beneficiary's notice under clause 4 or clause 5 refers to the Beneficiary’s nominee, the Beneficiary shall be liable to the Trade-Contractor, as guarantor, for the payment of any sums due and payable from time to time to the Trade-Contractor from the Beneficiary’s nominee.

children.name: text
children: {b:NO INSTRUCTIONS TO TRADE-CONTRACTOR BY BENEFICIARY}

children.name: text
children: Unless the Beneficiary has stepped-in under clause {b:4} or clause {b:5}, the Beneficiary may not give instructions to the Trade-Contractor under this agreement.

children.name: text
children: {b:COPYRIGHT}

children.name: text
children: The Trade-Contractor grants to the Beneficiary, with immediate effect, an irrevocable, non-exclusive, non-terminable, royalty-free licence to copy and make full use of any Material prepared by, or on behalf of, the Trade-Contractor for any purpose relating to the Works and the Property, including any of the Permitted Uses.

children.name: text
children: The licence in clause {b:9.1} carries the right to grant sub-licences and is transferable to third parties without the consent of the Trade-Contractor.

children.name: text
children: The Trade-Contractor shall not be liable for use of the Material for any purpose other than that for which it was prepared and/or provided.

children.name: text
children: The Beneficiary may request a copy (or copies) of some or all of the Material from the Trade-Contractor. On the Beneficiary’s payment of the Trade-Contractor’s reasonable charges for providing the copy (or copies), the Trade-Contractor shall provide the copy (or copies) to the Beneficiary.

children.name: text
children: {b:PROFESSIONAL INDEMNITY INSURANCE}

children.name: text
children: The Trade-Contractor shall maintain professional indemnity insurance for an amount of at least {ProfessionalLiabilityRequirement} for any one occurrence, or series of occurrences, arising out of any one event for a period beginning on the date of this agreement and ending 12 years after the date of practical completion of the Works, provided that such insurance is available at commercially reasonable rates. The Trade-Contractor shall maintain that professional indemnity insurance:

children.name: text
children: with reputable insurers lawfully carrying on insurance business in the UK;

children.name: text
children: on customary and usual terms and conditions prevailing for the time being in the insurance market; and

children.name: text
children: on terms that:

children.name: text
children: do not require the Trade-Contractor to discharge any liability before being entitled to recover from the insurers; and

children.name: text
children: would not adversely affect the rights of any person to recover from the insurers under the Third Parties (Rights Against Insurers) Act 2010.

children.name: text
children: Any increased or additional premium required by insurers because of the Trade-Contractor’s claims record or other acts, omissions, matters or things particular to the Trade-Contractor shall be deemed to be within commercially reasonable rates.

children.name: text
children: The Trade-Contractor shall immediately inform the Beneficiary if the Trade-Contractor’s required professional indemnity insurance ceases to be available at commercially reasonable rates, so that the Trade-Contractor and the Beneficiary can discuss how best to protect the respective positions of the Beneficiary and the Trade-Contractor regarding the Works and the Property, without that insurance.

children.name: text
children: The Trade-Contractor shall fully co-operate with any measures reasonably required by the Beneficiary, including:

children.name: text
children: completing any proposals for insurance and associated documents; or

children.name: text
children: maintaining insurance at rates above commercially reasonable rates, if the Beneficiary reimburses the Trade-Contractor for the net cost of that insurance above commercially reasonable rates.

children.name: text
children: Whenever the Beneficiary reasonably requests, the Trade-Contractor shall send the Beneficiary evidence that the Trade-Contractor's professional indemnity insurance is in force, including, if required by the Beneficiary, an original letter from the Trade-Contractor's insurers or brokers confirming:

children.name: text
children: the Trade-Contractor's then current professional indemnity insurance; and

children.name: text
children: that the premiums for that insurance have been paid in full at the date of that letter.

children.name: text
children: {b:LIABILITY PERIOD}

children.name: text
children: The Beneficiary may not commence any legal action against the Trade-Contractor under this agreement after 12 years from the date of practical completion of all of the Works.

children.name: text
children: {b:ASSIGNMENT}

children.name: text
children: The Beneficiary may assign the benefit of this agreement without the Employer and the Trade-Contractor's consent:

children.name: text
children: on two occasions to any person; and

children.name: text
children: without counting as an assignment under clause {b:12.1.1}:

children.name: text
children: by way of security (including any reassignment on redemption of security); or

children.name: text
children: to a member of its Group for so long as that company remains a member of its Group.

children.name: text
children: The Beneficiary shall notify the Trade-Contractor and the Employer of any assignment.

children.name: text
children: The Trade-Contractor shall not contend that any person to whom the benefit of this agreement is assigned under clause {b:12.1} may not recover any sum under this agreement because that person is an assignee only or otherwise is not the original Beneficiary or because the loss or damage suffered has been suffered by such person only and not by the original Beneficiary, or because such loss is different from that which would have been suffered by the original Beneficiary.

children.name: text
children: {b:NOTICES}

children.name: text
children: A notice given to a party under or in connection with this agreement shall be in writing and sent to the party at the address given in this agreement or as otherwise notified in writing to each other party.

children.name: text
children: This clause {b:13.2} sets out the delivery methods for sending a notice to a party under this agreement and, for each delivery method, the date and time when the notice is deemed to have been received:

children.name: text
children: if delivered by hand, at the time the notice is left at the proper address; or

children.name: text
children: if sent by pre-paid first class post or other next working day delivery service providing proof of postage, at 9.00am on the second Business Day after posting.

children.name: text
children: If deemed receipt under clause {b:13.2} would occur outside business hours in the place of receipt, it shall be deferred until business hours resume. In this clause {b:13.3}, business hours means 9.00am to 5.00pm Monday to Friday on a day that is not a public holiday in the place of receipt.

children.name: text
children: This clause does not apply to the service of any proceedings or other documents in any legal action or, where applicable, any arbitration or other method of dispute resolution.

children.name: text
children: {b:THIRD PARTY RIGHTS}

children.name: text
children: This agreement does not give rise to any rights under the Contracts (Rights of Third Parties) Act 1999 to enforce any term of this agreement.

children.name: text
children: {b:GOVERNING LAW}

children.name: text
children: This agreement and any dispute or claim (including non-contractual disputes or claims) arising out of or in connection with it or its subject matter or formation shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the law of England and Wales.

children.name: text
children: {b:JURISDICTION}

children.name: text
children: Each party irrevocably agrees that the courts of England and Wales shall have exclusive jurisdiction to settle any dispute or claim (including non-contractual disputes or claims) arising out of or in connection with this agreement or its subject matter or formation.
